title: Draft: asn2wrs: Field unique abbreviations follow up
description:
Add the unique suffix ("_01", etc.) for duplicated fields to the
abbreviation as well. Don't do it for FT_NONE fields, since those
have "_element" added to their abbreviation already.
(Commit 0ee4d0a00abd69e6479a55c12425c92cdf916d71 - if we do add
that suffix to FT_NONE fields, perhaps revert that commit.)

This clears up all the non-compatible ASN.1 fields sharing
abbreviations. It also makes unique some compatible fields that
share a name but have different types - sometimes with unique
value strings, sometimes basically identical, e.g. perhaps with
a size constraint that isn't PER-visible, or that doesn't affect
how we dissect it.

Ping #2402

commits_data.message:
asn2wrs: Field unique abbreviations follow up

Add the unique suffix ("_01", etc.) for duplicated fields to the
abbreviation as well. Don't do it for FT_NONE fields, since those
have "_element" added to their abbreviation already.
(Commit 0ee4d0a00abd69e6479a55c12425c92cdf916d71 - if we do add
that suffix to FT_NONE fields, perhaps revert that commit.)

This clears up all the non-compatible ASN.1 fields sharing
abbreviations. It also makes unique some compatible fields that
share a name but have different types - sometimes with unique
value strings, sometimes basically identical, e.g. perhaps with
a size constraint that isn't PER-visible, or that doesn't affect
how we dissect it.

Ping #2402
